stations.title: Ravi
stations.say: Can Moss fill the order sheet?

stations.title: Moss
stations.text: Sends JSON that is almost right.
stations.note: Numbers as words, in a fence.

stations.title: Order sheet
stations.text: Plant, quantity, pot size, gift wrap.

captions: The inbox is sorted. Now Ravi wants order emails copied into the order sheet.
An email asks for three orchids, and Moss sends back JSON that is almost right.
You write the code that finds, checks and repairs the reply, in three tasks.
Now the orchid order lands on the sheet with every field the right type.
Same email, no typing for Ravi. Nothing broken reaches the sheet.
